description: Test specifications for various selector querying capabilities in Playwright, including CSS, text, XPath, and complex selector combinations within the framework.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Test case function used to define individual tests.

ctags.name: divsCount
ctags.pattern: /^  const divsCount = await page.$$eval('css=div', divs => divs.length);$/

ctags.name: divsCount
ctags.pattern: /^  const divsCount = await page.$$eval('div', divs => divs.length);$/

ctags.name: divsCount
ctags.pattern: /^  const divsCount = await page.$$eval('text="beautiful"', divs => divs.length);$/

ctags.name: divsCount
ctags.pattern: /^  const divsCount = await page.$$eval('xpath=\/html\/body\/div', divs => divs.length);$/

ctags.name: spansCount
ctags.pattern: /^  const spansCount = await page.$$eval('css=div >> css=span', spans => spans.length);$/

ctags.name: texts
ctags.pattern: /^  const texts = await page.$$eval('css=div', divs => divs.map(div => div.textContent));$/
